facts.text: Willy, I saved you the good fish from the bucket. Eat up, big guy, you need your strength for tonight.
facts.why: The quote page opened lists other characters and no line like this from Jesse. As a note it fits the plot, but it is printed in quote marks as dialogue.
facts.fix: Use a note: Willy, I saved you the good fish. Eat up, big guy, because we are getting you home tonight.

facts.text: Jesse's park kiosk chilli cheese dogs
facts.why: Plot summaries show Jesse sneaking into the park and falling into Willy's tank. None give him a kiosk job, and the transcript has no kiosk.

facts.text: For the night drive to the cove.
facts.why: Wikipedia and the transcript have the escape truck heading for Dawson's Marina, the only ocean access for miles. No cove is named.
facts.fix: For the night drive to the marina.
